# TaruviBase Agent Plugin

The TaruviBase Agent Plugin bundles TaruviBase skills and the TaruviBase MCP server
(`https://mcp.taruvibase.com/mcp`, OAuth) for many AI coding agents from one shared
`skills/` directory.

Use this file as the agent-facing index for the repository. For install steps,
start with [README.md](README.md). For the repository layout and editing rules,
read [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md).

## Skills

### taruvi-setup

[skills/taruvi-setup/SKILL.md](skills/taruvi-setup/SKILL.md) — "setup taruvi":
confirm the MCP connection and write the app's `.env`.

### taruvi-app-developer

Use [skills/taruvi-app-developer/SKILL.md](skills/taruvi-app-developer/SKILL.md)
for TaruviBase backend work: datatables, access policies, roles, users, buckets,
secrets, analytics queries, and Python function bodies that run in the
TaruviBase function runtime.

Key references:

- [architecture-overview.md](skills/taruvi-app-developer/references/architecture-overview.md)
- [mcp-tool-quickref.md](skills/taruvi-app-developer/references/mcp-tool-quickref.md)
- [datatable-schema-patterns.md](skills/taruvi-app-developer/references/datatable-schema-patterns.md)
- [cerbos-policy-cookbook.md](skills/taruvi-app-developer/references/cerbos-policy-cookbook.md)
- [function-authoring.md](skills/taruvi-app-developer/references/function-authoring.md)
- [function-sdk-reference.md](skills/taruvi-app-developer/references/function-sdk-reference.md)
- [feature-workflow-examples.md](skills/taruvi-app-developer/references/feature-workflow-examples.md)

### taruvi-refine-providers

Use [skills/taruvi-refine-providers/SKILL.md](skills/taruvi-refine-providers/SKILL.md)
for Refine.dev frontend work in TaruviBase apps: data, storage, app, user, auth,
and access control providers; Refine hooks; list pages; dashboards; uploads;
permission-aware UI; and frontend calls to TaruviBase functions or analytics.

Key references:

- [overview.md](skills/taruvi-refine-providers/references/overview.md)
- [database-provider.md](skills/taruvi-refine-providers/references/database-provider.md)
- [storage-provider.md](skills/taruvi-refine-providers/references/storage-provider.md)
- [app-provider.md](skills/taruvi-refine-providers/references/app-provider.md)
- [user-provider.md](skills/taruvi-refine-providers/references/user-provider.md)
- [auth-provider.md](skills/taruvi-refine-providers/references/auth-provider.md)
- [access-control-provider.md](skills/taruvi-refine-providers/references/access-control-provider.md)
- [types-and-utilities.md](skills/taruvi-refine-providers/references/types-and-utilities.md)
